name: Mei Demir
headline: Security and Software Engineer
summary: Security-focused software engineer with a track record of building secure backend components, strengthening authentication flows, and improving test coverage across product teams. Experienced in low-level systems work, code review, and coordinated delivery with cross-functional partners. Comfortable turning security requirements into practical implementation and test plans.

roles.title: Junior Security Engineer
bullets: Built secure backend components in C and Go, and tightened OAuth handling for authentication flows.
Reduced recurring access issues by 28% through Rust fixes in shared security code and careful review of edge cases.
Investigated incidents and improved the reliability of low-level services with C while supporting release checks.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Delivered product features in C++ and Rust, using OAuth to protect user sessions and sensitive operations.
Expanded automated checks with Cypress and Git, cutting late defect escapes by 31% across monthly releases.
Reviewed changes from other engineers and kept the codebase stable through disciplined version control practices.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Shipped security-focused features in C++ under Agile delivery, aligning implementation with IAM and OAuth requirements.
Strengthened release confidence with Burp Suite, OWASP and Threat modeling, helping remove 22 high-risk findings before launch.
Improved Test automation with Cypress and Git, raising coverage for critical user journeys and reducing manual regression effort.
Partnered with the team on defect triage and implementation reviews, keeping secure changes moving through the backlog.

roles.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Led secure feature work in C, C++ and TypeScript, coordinating Agile delivery across a team of 8 engineers.
Improved authentication and access flows with IAM, OAuth and Go services, reducing support tickets by 19%.
Expanded security validation with Burp Suite, OWASP, pytest and Test automation, catching issues earlier in the release cycle.
Drove Threat modeling workshops and applied the results to product changes, strengthening design decisions before implementation.
Built and maintained Cypress checks for key journeys, helping stabilize releases and shorten verification time.
